title: Study Guide Artifact Firewall: prompt-label leakage stops at shared lesson helpers

claims.summary: Fresh Project Management ZIP/log evidence showed a 74/C package because prompt artifact labels reached Study Guides and Course FAQ-style lesson language as concepts.
Shared lesson concept, artifact, source-cue, prerequisite, transfer, teaching-intent, and assessment metadata helpers reject prompt artifact labels and internal source placeholders.
Study Guide compilation now uses sanitized concepts, artifacts, source cues, key terms, exam-prep tags, and source-grounding display metadata instead of raw CourseIR labels.
The release keeps the strict grader and documents source/research bridging, enrichment coverage, and texture as carry-forward quality targets.

carryForward.next: Retry or block earlier with clear repair when enrichment covers only a subset of the requested lessons.
Bridge retrieved source-finder/OpenAlex resources into trusted concept-linked source ledger rows and reject off-discipline readings before export.
Improve deterministic variation and repeated-phrase cleanup for Study Guides and slide decks.
Run a fresh EduTool.dev ZIP/log audit after v0.15.57 deploys and compare regrade score, source ledger, texture, digest caveats, and export warnings.
